intro: CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini is a creamy, Mediterranean-inspired dressing that brings together ground sesame tahini, fresh lemon juice, and aromatic herbs. Available on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), this versatile sauce adds bright, nutty flavor to any bowl or pita. At just 70 calories per serving, it delivers rich taste without compromising your health goals when building meals from the [full CAVA menu](/). This signature dressing complements both traditional and modern Mediterranean flavors perfectly.
priceCalories: Lemon Herb Tahini comes included with your meal at CAVA, allowing up to 2 dressings at no additional cost. Each serving contains only 70 calories, making it one of the lighter dressing options available. With 2g of protein, 4g of carbs, and 6g of fat, it offers balanced nutrition that enhances your bowl or pita without adding excessive calories. This makes it an excellent choice for health-conscious diners exploring the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Lemon Herb Tahini apart is its perfect balance of creamy sesame richness and bright citrus notes. The combination of ground tahini and fresh lemon juice creates a smooth, pourable consistency that coats every ingredient evenly. The addition of Mediterranean herbs adds aromatic complexity that elevates simple ingredients. This thoughtfully crafted dressing reflects CAVA's commitment to authentic flavors found throughout their [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Lemon Herb Tahini provides 70 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 2g protein, 4g carbohydrates, and 6g fat. The tahini base offers heart-healthy fats and plant-based protein, while the lemon juice adds vitamin C. This dressing is naturally dairy-free and vegan-friendly, making it suitable for various dietary preferences. Those checking the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) should note it contains sesame.
whatsInside: Lemon Herb Tahini features three primary components: ground sesame tahini as the creamy base, fresh lemon juice for brightness, and a blend of Mediterranean herbs. The tahini provides the signature nutty flavor and smooth texture, while lemon juice adds acidity and freshness. The herbs contribute aromatic depth and authentic Mediterranean character. This simple yet effective ingredient list ensures clean, recognizable flavors that pair well with items from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases).
tasteLike: Lemon Herb Tahini delivers a creamy, nutty flavor with bright citrus notes and herbal undertones. The sesame tahini provides rich, earthy depth, while fresh lemon juice cuts through with tangy brightness. The herbs add savory complexity without overwhelming the palate. The texture is smooth and pourable, coating ingredients evenly while maintaining a light feel. This balanced flavor profile complements both mild and bold ingredients across the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
customize: Customize your CAVA experience by combining Lemon Herb Tahini with other complementary flavors. Pair it with Hot Harissa Vinaigrette for a spicy-creamy combination, or add Skhug for herbal heat. Since CAVA allows up to 2 dressings included, experiment with layering flavors. Try it over different bases like SuperGreens or grains, and combine with various proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) to discover your perfect flavor balance.
pairsWell: Lemon Herb Tahini pairs exceptionally well with grilled chicken, falafel, and roasted vegetables. It complements the creamy richness of hummus and completes the flavor profile of Mediterranean grain bowls. The citrus notes enhance fresh vegetables like tomatoes and cucumbers, while the tahini base balances spicy toppings. This dressing works beautifully in both [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) items and custom-built bowls, offering versatility across the entire menu.
healthyChoice: At only 70 calories per serving, Lemon Herb Tahini ranks among the lighter dressing options at CAVA. The tahini provides plant-based protein and healthy fats that promote satiety and nutrient absorption. Unlike creamy dressings made with dairy, this option is naturally vegan and offers clean ingredients. The sesame seeds in tahini contain minerals like calcium and iron. For those following specific diets, check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for compatible options.
howToOrder: To order Lemon Herb Tahini, simply build your bowl or pita and select it from the dressings section. You can choose up to 2 dressings included with your meal at no extra charge. Request it on the side if you prefer to control the amount, or have it drizzled directly over your ingredients. The staff can adjust the quantity to your preference. Explore the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) for additional flavor enhancers.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Greek Vinaigrette at 130 calories, Lemon Herb Tahini offers 60 fewer calories while providing creamier texture. Unlike Garlic Dressing at 180 calories, it delivers lighter richness with citrus brightness. Hot Harissa Vinaigrette matches its 70 calories but offers spicy heat versus herbal creaminess. Skhug at 80 calories provides bold herb flavor with more intensity. Each dressing brings unique characteristics, allowing you to customize your meal based on flavor preferences and nutritional goals.
whoShouldTry: Lemon Herb Tahini is perfect for Mediterranean cuisine enthusiasts who appreciate authentic flavors. Health-conscious diners seeking flavorful low-calorie options will appreciate its balanced nutrition. Vegetarians and vegans benefit from its plant-based protein and dairy-free formulation. Those new to tahini-based dressings will find this an approachable introduction with familiar lemon and herb notes. Anyone building a customized meal should consider this versatile dressing for added depth.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying, Lemon Herb Tahini represents CAVA's commitment to flavorful, health-conscious Mediterranean cuisine. Its versatility makes it suitable for virtually any combination of bases, proteins, and toppings. The balanced nutrition allows you to enjoy creamy richness without calorie concerns. Being included with your meal means you can experiment risk-free. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-time visitor, this dressing enhances your dining experience with authentic Mediterranean flavor.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini?
faqs.a: CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini contains 70 calories per serving, making it one of the lighter dressing options available. It provides 2g of protein, 4g of carbohydrates, and 6g of fat, offering balanced nutrition without excessive calories for your bowl or pita.

faqs.q: Is Lemon Herb Tahini included or does it cost extra?
faqs.a: Lemon Herb Tahini is included with your CAVA meal at no additional cost. You can select up to 2 dressings per order without extra charges, allowing you to combine flavors or use this dressing alongside another option from the dressings menu.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini?
faqs.a: CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini is made with ground sesame tahini, fresh lemon juice, and Mediterranean herbs. This simple, clean ingredient list creates a creamy, flavorful dressing that is naturally vegan and dairy-free while delivering authentic Mediterranean taste.

faqs.q: Is Lemon Herb Tahini vegan and gluten-free?
faqs.a: Yes, Lemon Herb Tahini is vegan as it contains only plant-based ingredients including sesame tahini, lemon juice, and herbs. It is also gluten-free, making it suitable for various dietary preferences. However, it does contain sesame, which is a common allergen.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Lemon Herb Tahini taste like?
faqs.a: Lemon Herb Tahini offers a creamy, nutty flavor from the sesame tahini base, balanced with bright citrus notes from fresh lemon juice. Mediterranean herbs add aromatic depth, creating a smooth, well-rounded dressing that complements both mild and bold ingredients throughout your meal.
